svg.title: Proposed regional system architecture
svg.desc: The template service supplies approved artifact bytes and hashes to the summary service, which verifies and compares them before archiving localized summaries. The firm's updates API selects offers from regional release and engagement data and serves archived summaries with view receipts. A planner publishes verification jobs to regional SQS. The Java worker reconciles them through the engagement manager, which owns downstream admission and effects.
